# omada_wlan_group (Resource)

An Omada WLAN group containing one or more SSIDs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "omada_wlan_group" "floor_one" {
  name = "Floor One"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) WLAN group name.

### Optional

- `site_id` (String) Site ID. Defaults to the provider site.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the controller's primary WLAN group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import IDs use site-name-or-ID:wlan-group-ID.
terraform import omada_wlan_group.floor_one 'Default:6a9ef808c7e1e27192728694'
```
